Please sec attached the Daily Portfolio Report for 4/2. Have a good day! 
Daily Commentary 
We wanted to highlight monetization of P&L off of peak MTM. In this case CELG. Peak MTM of 
$14,105 was achieved on February 18th. From 3/13 to 3/25 the system received an opposing 
trade signal and we closed the position. The total realized gain was $11,125. The factors 
determining the variability of monetization is (i) how quickly realized vol changes in the very 
near term and (ii) net/gross movement over the equivalent period. 
In the context of the overall portfolio, daily volatility and drawdowns are a function of (i) the net exposure 
and (ii) the portfolio correlation. Generally, the extremes of these two values are 'right-war risk 
for us. To reach extreme levels requires (i) a period of time for the portfolio to transition to 
those levels if portfolio construction is not failing and (ii) we are experiencing large MTM gains 
as to add to positions and increase leverage.

Spring Arrivals at Capstar 
We are starting to see blue sky and sunshine after what feels like the wettest winter in years. 
Appropriately for the new season, its all very much about growth this month. We are receiving 
delivery of six brand new long-wheel base Jaguar XJs this week-straight off the production 
line. All of our cars have also been fitted with the distinctive Capstar 'Garter Star' on the front 
grille and the new badges are already turning heads! 
We are always looking for ways to improve your experience with Capstar, and this month we 
have updates planned for our website that will make it even easier for you to book a 
Capstar Chauffeur. 
In response to demand the Range Rover, one of our future fleet additions, made its debut at 
our recent photo shoot. We are looking forward to announcing the updated fleet in time for the 
shooting season, as well as luxury people carriers very soon. 
Along with the promise of better weather and longer days, we are starting to look forward to all 
the summer season has to offer in terms of major events. So whether it's a corporate 
occasion which needs a dose of Capstar style, or a Chauffeur for yourself, we'd love to help 
make your day even more enjoyable. 
Thank you, 
Charlie Bowmont, 
Managing Director of Capstar Chauffeurs
